newsitem.title: MEXICO: 15 reported dead in Mexico bus crash.
newsitem.headline: 15 reported dead in Mexico bus crash.

text.p: Fifteen people were killed and 10 injured on Monday when a passenger bus and a truck collided in northern Mexico, television network Televisa reported.
Televisa said the bus caught fire after the collision in northern Tamaulipas state, bordering Texas about 300 miles (550 km) north of Mexico City.
State and federal government officials were not immediately available for comment on the report.
